tbesh_html:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12;
son of: Immer (H0564);
father of: Meshullam (H4918M); also called Meshillemoth at Neh.11.13;
Also named: me.shil.le.mot (מְשִׁלֵּמוֹת "Meshillemoth" H4919H)
§ Meshillemith = "recompense"
a priest, son of Immer. See also 'Meshillemoth'
